paragraphs.text: Rukarumel was a Rift Era human biologist and wizard who made it her life's work to study the slivers that had come to Dominaria from Rath and their evolution's many forms.

Rukarumel wore a biologist's robes and glasses and wore her wild black hair cut at the neck. In her inspections, she used numerous apparatuses with focal lenses and kept vigorous field notes on many types of slivers. She could grow base slivers in her specimen lab and expose them to different varieties of captured slivers that she kept in glass containers.
